title: Mhiko yeVasati Vaberekwa
intro: Mweya wechokwadi wakaita vimbiso tsvene mwana asati asvika. Nyaya yemunhu uyu inobuda mukati memadziro enzvimbo tsvene, uko kuzvipira kunogamuchirwa naMwari. Ndiani uyu mushandiri waAllah?
clues: Ndakapika mhiko huru yekutsaurira mwana wangu asati aberekwa kubasa raAllah.
Pandakazvara mwana, ndakashamisika kuona kuti aive mwanasikana, kunyange zvazvo ndaitarisira kuva nemwanakomana.
Ndakatumidza mwana wangu zita rekuti Maryam, zita rinoratidza kuzvipira uye kushumira.
Ndakakumbira dziviriro kuna Allah yemwana wangu nevana vake kubva kuna Satani akatukwa.
Mwana wangu akagamuchirwa naShe ndokuiswa pasi pekutarisirwa kwaMuporofita Zakariya munzvimbo tsvene.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
